{{Quote|We will celebrate the anniversary of this day as Empire Day. For the sake of our children. For our children's children! For the next ten thousand years!|Emperor Palpatine|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (novelization)">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>}}
'''Empire Day''' was a galactic holiday celebrated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The observance of Empire Day began in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], when [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] proclaimed the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to be over and [[Imperialization/Legends|reorganized]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] into the First Galactic Empire via the [[Declaration of a New Order]]. In his declaration, Palpatine mandated that Imperial citizens would celebrate the anniversary of Empire's creation yearly, for the sake of posterity. Although the first Empire Day was marked by several attempts by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to dismantle the Empire, the new government and the tradition lived on. When the rebellious [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] formed in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], its members protested the celebration of Empire Day. In a symbolic show of solidarity with the Old Republic, the Alliance began celebrating [[Remembrance Day]] on the same date as the Empire's galactic holiday. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], both the Empire and the Alliance ramped up propaganda efforts to promote the observation of the respective holidays.

Empire Day was celebrated in a number of different ways, depending on region and culture. Although the holiday fell on one day of the [[Standard year/Legends|year]], celebrations in some corners of the Empire continued for weeks. Such jubilation could be found on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], where the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] played host to [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] parades and statues of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine for days. During this time, the Empire provided loyal citizens with goods that promoted state pride, such as food rations and artwork.

==Description==
{{Quote|Citizens of the civilized galaxy, on this day we mark a transition.|Palpatine, in his Declaration of a New Order|<ref name="Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref>}}
Empire Day was a galactic holiday of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], celebrated from [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] to at least [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]]. The anniversary of the Empire's creation was celebrated yearly, on the twenty-third day of the fifth month using the [[Great ReSynchronization]] (GrS) dating system based on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Despite the holiday falling on a single date of the year, celebrations of the event could last for several days or even weeks in certain regions of the Empire, depending on the local culture.

The holiday commemorated the dissolution of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the creation of the Empire by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]]&ndash;turned&ndash;[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The day also celebrated the might and power of the Empire, as well as that of Palpatine himself. [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] parades were common on Empire Day, as was as the display of statues of the Emperor in public squares. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Imperials used the holiday as an opportunity to step up propaganda efforts and further Palpatine's cult of personality. Government workers distributed Empire Day memorabilia to passersby, and Imperial citizens offered one another salutations of "Happy Empire Day." Many individuals loyal to the Empire celebrated with family or friends, while others sought to be close to their Emperor on his holiday. Because of Palpatine's reclusive habits, few saw this wish realized.

It also saw the opportunity to award personnel of the Empire with various medals for significant acts of service. These included the [[Imperial Badge of Meritorious Service]], the [[Imperial Engineering Volunteer]], the [[Imperial Guest Performance]], the [[Imperial Anti-Propaganda Enforcer]] and the [[Champion of Empire Day]] awards, the last of which Darth Vader personally awarded.

Although practiced by various parts of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the time of the Galactic Civil War, it was most celebrated on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] capital city, [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], due to the planet being Palpatine's homeworld. Festivities on Theed during this time included awarding medals, erecting statues of the Emperor, and military parades that included [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], at least two [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]], and [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Imperial Marines]].

==History==
===The first Empire Day===
{{Quote|Why, Master Yoda, what a delightful surprise! Welcome! Let me be the first to wish you Happy Empire Day!|Newly self-declared Emperor Palpatine, to Master Yoda in 19 BBY|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (novelization)" />}}
[[File:Declaration2.png|thumb|left|280px|Palpatine creates Empire Day by transforming the democratic Republic into an authoritarian regime.]]
After three years of fighting between the Galactic Republic and the breakaway [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] came to a close in 19 BBY, when the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] Darth Sidious decided that the pieces were in place to allow him to seize control of the galaxy. In his alter ego of Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, Sidious enticed the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to [[Showdown on Coruscant|attack him]]&mdash;an attempt that ultimately failed, and provided the Chancellor with a pretense for issuing [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|Contingency Order]] [[Order 66/Legends|66]] to the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. While [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] across the galaxy [[Death/Legends|killed]] their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] commanders pursuant to the Order, Sidious dispatched his new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|assassinate]] the [[Separatist Council/Legends|leaders of the Confederacy]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Vader continued on to deactivate the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|armies]] of the Confederacy, ending the carnage of the Clone Wars.

With the Confederate rebellion defeated and his Jedi enemies crushed, Palpatine called an [[Special session of Congress/Legends|Extraordinary Session]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] on the twenty-third day of the fifth [[Standard month/Legends|month]] of 16 GrS. That afternoon, he presented to the Senate evidence of an anti-government Jedi conspiracy before issuing his historic [[Declaration of a New Order]]. In the Declaration, Palpatine proclaimed the Clone Wars to be over, transformed the Republic into the First Galactic Empire, and mandated that the anniversary of the Empire's creation be celebrated by Imperial citizens for the sake of their children and future generations. The newly proclaimed Emperor predicted that Empire Day would be celebrated for ten thousand years before concluding his speech. That inaugural Empire Day was marked by two separate attempts by surviving Jedi to destroy the new regime.

The first attempt was made by [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the now-defunct Jedi Order and one of the last surviving Jedi. He traveled to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] immediately following Palpatine's Declaration and confronted the Emperor in his [[Chancellor's working office/Legends|Holding Office]]. The two engaged in a [[Skirmish in the Senate|fierce duel]] in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] of the Senate itself. The second attempt was made by surviving [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] member [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|sought to kill Darth Vader]] on Mustafar. Both attempts failed, as Yoda was forced to retreat from his duel and Kenobi found himself unable to execute Vader after maiming him. As such, both the Empire and the tradition of Empire Day lived on.

===An enduring tradition===
{{Quote|Loyal Imperial citizens, we are here today to celebrate the day when our Emperor made his Declaration of a New Order and dissolved the Galactic Republic. Out of the ashes the Emperor formed the mighty and invincible Empire we are today. It was not an easy task, even for the Emperor. Without the help of extraordinary Imperial citizens, it could not have been done.|Imperial Executor Darth Vader, in an Empire Day speech on Naboo|<ref name="SWG:TCOA">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>}}
[[File:EmpireDayTheed.jpg|280px|thumb|An Empire Day parade in Theed]]
After that first celebration, Empire Day became an annual celebration across the Empire, which was celebrated between beings by saying "Happy Empire Day."

After the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], Empire Day was emphasized more vehemently, by both the Empire ''and'' the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]]. The Rebellion adopted the term [[Remembrance Day]] in place of Empire Day, and used Empire Day as a way to remind citizens of the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. During one such Empire Day in 1 ABY, Lord Vader landed in front of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] to deliver a speech to a crowd of loyal Imperial citizens.

Guarded by a group of [[Triumphant-class dark trooper]]s, Darth Vader used the holiday to honor those who served the Empire graciously. As Vader stood in front of a statue of the Emperor, he called out several soldiers present by name, giving them a badge for their service. After his short visit, he boarded his [[ST 321/Legends|shuttle]] to leave the planet. As he departed, Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] flew by as [[Fireworks/Legends|fireworks]] exploded overhead.

During the Empire Day festivities, [[Brenn Tantor]] tasked loyal Imperials with tearing down Rebel [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]] posters around the city, and putting up posters which proclaimed, "Join Us." [[K3|Kaythree]] tasked Imperial traders with gathering supplies from crashed shuttles, and gave [[entertainer]]s the option to entertain Imperial soldiers in the Theed [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. [[Dac Madine]] stood by to receive any incoming shipments. [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] also participated in the Empire Day festivities, tasking an Imperial operative with rescuing six Imperial officers from a prison facility in a [[Hidden Rebel Base|hidden Rebel base]].

Due to the heavy Imperial patrols in Theed, the Rebellion did little to stop the Empire Day festivities from taking place. However, there were reports of Rebel agents gunning down those who put up Imperial posters. In addition, at least a few of the Imperial recruitment posters ended up defaced by Rebel sympathizers, some of which were sold by Rebel Celebration Organizers and even Imperial Celebration Organizers.

During festivities, various souvenirs were also sold and handed out, including paintings and posters (Darth Vader, Princess Leia, etc.), models (decoration devices and space-station models), decorative sashes, an automated target dummy (based on either the Rebels or the Empire) and tools ([[Novaless Soni-Optics/Legends|Novaless Soni-Optics]] [[Goggles Mark V]]). Although some were exclusive to either Empire Day or Remembrance Day, most of them were available on both holidays. In addition, a [[Imperial Celebration Organizer|celebration organizer]] often stood near the [[Empire Day Emperor's Statue|statue of Emperor Palpatine]] at the stairs to Theed Palace, where he sold various pro-Imperial rations such as [[Gracious Government Mix]] and [[Order 66 Cookie]]s to those loyal to the Empire. However, due to his being trained to detect any Rebel infiltrators, he turned away any Rebel-aligned soldiers who tried to receive any of the rations.

==Behind the scenes==
In the real-world, the [[Wikipedia:British Empire|British Empire]] celebrated [[Wikipedia:Commonwealth Day|Empire Day]] on [[May 24]], the birthday of [[Wikipedia:Queen Victoria|Queen Victoria]], and the holiday was rebranded as "Commonwealth Day" in the [[Wikipedia:United Kingdom|United Kingdom]] and the [[Wikipedia:Commonwealth of Nations|Commonwealth of Nations]].<ref name="Old Vic">{{WebCite|url=http://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/commonwealth-day|text=Commonwealth Day|work=[https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com Oxford Learner's Dictionary]|archivedate=20171009195025}}</ref> The royal charity premiere of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] was held in the British capital, [[Wikipedia:London|London]], on [[May 20]], 1980, and "Empire Day" was used in the marketing for the event,<ref name="Empire Day real">{{SW|url=news/an-empire-day-to-remember|text=An 'Empire Day' to Remember}}</ref> which was attended by [[Wikipedia:Princess Margaret, Countess of Snowdon|Princess Margaret]] and benefited children's charities.<ref name="Evening News">{{WebCite|url=https://www.tiefighters.com/post/102938129372/an-empire-day-to-remember-back-in-1980-when-the|text=IT'S EMPIRE DAY TODAY|author=Mottram, Terry|date=1980-05-20|work=[[Wikipedia:The Evening News (London newspaper)|''Evening News'']], via [https://www.tiefighters.com TieFighters]|archiveurl=https://archive.is/zewnS}}</ref>

Empire Day was a recurring event in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. The celebrations took part on the anniversary of the game's launch, every year since 2005. In 2008, once every hour, an [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Imperial shuttle]] landed and Darth Vader called out one of the Imperial-aligned player characters present at the celebration. This player received a special badge and the title "Hero of Empire Day." All players that visited the celebrations received a special [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']] [[Five Years of Galaxies|movie poster]] and could buy [[Order 66 Cookie]]s and a [[Gracious Government Mix]], food that temporarily enhanced the players' stats.

This changed slightly in the 2009 celebration. Vader would land every 15 minutes and call out three players, who this time received the title "Champion of Empire Day." Players would also receive a [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']] [[Six Years of Galaxies|movie poster]] to commemorate the sixth anniversary of ''Star Wars Galaxies''. In addition, the 2009 celebration included additional quests for players. The 2010 representation of Empire Day remained widely unchanged, except it offered players new badges, a few extra rewards, and a new title, "Chosen of Empire Day." The 2011 celebration saw little change with only new badges being added for completing the same tasks as previous years.
